hints.title: Coordinate Vector Shift
hints.text: Track coordinate differences between active pixels across both binary matrices to find the most frequent translation vector.

hints.title: Sparse Coordinate Extraction
hints.text: Extract list of (row, col) coordinates for all ones in both images.

hints.title: Translation Frequency Mode
hints.text: Compute delta = (r1 - r2, c1 - c2) for each point pair across the two sets. Count occurrences of each delta in a map and return the highest frequency.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: P1, P2: number of ones in img1 and img2
complexity.notes: Sparse coordinate pairs with translation frequency hashing.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all (2N - 1)^2 shift offsets against full N x N grids incurs (2N)^4 operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dictionary stores delta counts for active coordinate pairs.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Filter active ones to skip empty zeroes and hash translation vectors directly.
